company.name: DEE DAVIS INC
company.address: 755 W Big Beaver Rd, Suite 2020, Troy, MI 48084

introduction: DEE DAVIS INC is seeking competitive quotes from qualified suppliers for various padlocks to fulfill a 3-year term contract with a utility client in Texas. This contract requires reliable suppliers capable of providing high-quality padlocks with specific security features, custom stamping capabilities, and the ability to meet strict delivery requirements. We are looking for suppliers who can provide competitive wholesale pricing and demonstrate the ability to handle large volume orders with consistent quality and timely delivery.

scope_of_work.title: SCOPE OF WORK
scope_of_work.description: The supplier must provide various padlocks including brass body padlocks, combination padlocks, high-security steel padlocks, disposable padlocks, restricted padlocks, and shrouded padlock sets. Some items require custom stamping on the lock body. The supplier must be able to meet delivery requirements of within 5 business days of order placement and provide pricing that can be held firm for the first 6 months of the contract period. All products must meet the specified technical requirements and quality standards.
key_requirements: Custom stamping capability required for certain padlock models (lock body must be stamped with client name)
Ability to provide keyed-alike and keyed-different padlocks per specifications
Delivery within 5 business days of order placement
Pricing must remain firm for first 6 months of contract
All padlocks must meet specified security standards and technical specifications
Manufacturer part numbers must be provided where applicable
Volume pricing discounts expected for large quantity items

items.specifications: 3/8" diameter Grade 304 Stainless Steel Shackle, 1" clearance, 5-pin cylinder keyed alike to 389 with keys, body of lock MUST be stamped with client name
2" body width, 1" shackle length, dual deadlock mechanism, set your own 4-digit combination

Dual ball locking mechanism, 1-1/2" hardened boron alloy shackle, high security 5-pin cylinder with spool pins, 2 keys per 6 locks, body of lock MUST be stamped with client name, Manufacturer Part: M1KALFSTSLZ12KS, Manufacturer: MASTER LOCK
3" with integral stop, 1-1/2" clearance between body and hasp, single shear head screw metallic, meets client specification #989-09
Dual ball locking mechanism, hardened stainless steel 5/16" shackle, high security 5-pin cylinder, NO KEYS (restricted), body of lock MUST be stamped with client name

Shrouded padlock with 1-3/4" heavy hardened steel body, chrome rustproofing, 1-3/16" tall x 5/16" diameter hardened boron alloy shackle for superior cut resistance, 1 SET = 4 locks (boxed), keyed alike with 4 keys per set, NO TWO SETS TO BE KEYED ALIKE - All sets must be unique

submission_requirements.title: QUOTE SUBMISSION REQUIREMENTS
items: PRICING: Provide complete unit pricing for each line item with any volume discounts
MANUFACTURER INFO: Include manufacturer name and part number for each item
DELIVERY: Specify lead time in business days and confirm FOB terms (destination preferred)
SHIPPING: State whether freight is included in pricing or quote separately
QUOTE FORMAT: Respond via email with itemized pricing in Excel/PDF format
PAYMENT TERMS: State your standard payment terms (Net 30, Net 60, etc.)
QUOTE VALIDITY: Confirm how long pricing remains valid
CONTACT INFO: Include primary contact name, phone, and email for follow-up questions

items.title: Payment Terms
items.description: Net 30 days from invoice date. Purchase orders will be issued upon award.

items.title: Delivery Requirements
items.description: FOB Destination preferred (freight included in price). Specify lead times for each item.

items.title: Contract Period
items.description: 12 months with option to extend based on performance.

items.title: Product Quality
items.description: All products must be new, first-quality merchandise meeting manufacturer specifications.

items.title: Returns & Warranties
items.description: Defective items must be replaced within 5 business days at no charge.

items.title: Price Protection
items.description: Quoted prices remain firm for contract period unless mutually agreed in writing.
